components.purpose: Covers the entire request: renders a grid (Columns field, e.g. 4 so 8 items form 2 rows) of eight integration partner items. Each item is a linked FeatureItem content item with an Icon (ImageAttachment) for the partner's icon, a Title for the partner's name, and a Description (LongText) for the one-sentence blurb about the integration. The component's own Heading/Subheading fields can be used for an intro like 'Integration Partners'.
